description: Canonical Scene, Zone, and Entity Pop-up Notification Configuration for Guardian Runner (The Cycle of Vessels)

scenes.title: The Harvester's Brand
scenes.text: Andras's sigil burns in your palm. Cut your fallen captains free and seal his Rift before his 10,000-soul tithe opens the gate.

scenes.title: Andras, Marquis of Discord
scenes.text: Every soul your scythe reaps feeds the 10,000-soul tithe. Carve through your captains, Harvester - only a Watch oath can break my cage.

scenes.title: Muster Roll of the Watch
scenes.text: The names of Corporal Vane, Garrick, Solen, and Commander Kaelen are written here in ink that smells of ash...
scenes.description: Disabled redundant ponder popup to keep HUD uncluttered

scenes.title: Chronicle of the Fourth Vanguard
scenes.text: Left beside a cold watchfire, this field ledger records how the four captains locked Andras behind the Bleeding Tree.

scenes.title: Whispers in the Brush
scenes.text: Andras's voice echoes beneath your ribs.

scenes.title: Vane's Distress Marks
scenes.text: Deep hash-marks are gouged into the bark ahead.
scenes.description: Disabled redundant distance inquiry to prevent popup overload

scenes.title: Corporal Vane, The Weeping Husk
scenes.text: Clad in the tattered cloak of the Fourth Vanguard, Corporal Vane weeps crimson sap - his body puppeted by Andras's hunger!
scenes.description: Corporal Vane / Blood Zombie Boss Arena (Entity 14 @ 4,500m)

scenes.title: Ocular Prism: The Eye of Andras
scenes.text: Vane's final memory awakens the prism! Press [V] to invoke Demon Time - fracturing time while revealing the echoes of the fallen.

scenes.title: The Moonstone Keeper
scenes.text: Standing vigil among the Hollowed Graves, the Keeper weighs your soul: 'Do you still remember the faces of those you seek?'

scenes.title: Garrick, The Iron Bulwark
scenes.text: Your shield-brother Garrick stands fused to the Obsidian Arch - still keeping his oath that nothing shall pass the line!

scenes.title: Andras's True Design
scenes.text: Ten thousand restless echoes stir in your wake! Andras never meant to save your company - he is forging you into his final vessel.

scenes.title: Pyromancer Solen, The Ash Keeper
scenes.text: At the heart of Candora's ruined shrine, Pyromancer Solen fights the hellfire consuming his robes - protecting one last Silver Tear for you!

scenes.title: Commander Kaelen, The Hollowed Mentor
scenes.text: Beneath the Bleeding Great Tree stands Commander Kaelen - the mentor who taught you the blade, now bound as Andras's Dark Ronin!

scenes.title: Threshold of the Great Tree
scenes.text: The Bleeding Tree's roots part before you. The memories of the Fourth Vanguard - and the fate of your soul - converge at last.
